ImageDrop.Hint.zh: 在目标位置松手置入图片或工程，Esc 或 {0} 取消。
ImageDrop.Hint.en: Release at the desired position to place images or projects. Esc or {0} cancels.

ImageDrop.Unsupported.zh: 支持图像数据及 PNG、JPEG、BMP、GIF、WebP、.floatcanvas、.floatprefab 文件；工程链接需要实际文件路径，不支持网址或网页链接。
ImageDrop.Unsupported.en: Supports image data and PNG, JPEG, BMP, GIF, WebP, .floatcanvas and .floatprefab files. Linked projects require a real file path; URLs and web links are unsupported.

ImageDrop.Failed.zh:
置入失败：{0}
可以重新拖入文件或图片。
ImageDrop.Failed.en:
Placement failed: {0}
You can drag the files or images in again.

ImageDrop.TargetChanged.zh: 目标画布或编辑层级已变化，请重新拖入文件或图片。
ImageDrop.TargetChanged.en: The target canvas or editing level changed. Drag the files or images in again.
